subject: russian

fields.exceptions: minimal learner-safe exception metadata keyed by exception_id
fields.build_meta: optional compact integrity metadata; no source books/provenance payload

fields.exception_id: stable internal id; not normally displayed
fields.label: short learner-facing label
fields.practice_item_ids: eligible reviewed/source_verified practice IDs for this exception
fields.rule_ref: optional stable rule/explanation reference used to open rule drawer

fields.answer: machine evaluator data; must not be rendered before check
fields.distractors: optional if not embedded in prompt options
fields.topic_id: denormalized optional topic key for fast filtering

fields.next_action: optional UI-safe action code, not arbitrary HTML

excluded_from_runtime_payload: review_notes unless specifically converted to learner copy
wrong_forms lists unless required as actual distractors
current EGE answer banks unrelated to the selected practice payload
answer_security_note: This is a client-side free trainer, so answer data cannot be treated as secret against a determined user. The design goal is payload minimization and UI integrity, not false claims of secure exam delivery.
build_rules: runtime payload generated only from canonical machine-PASS source/practice banks
do not include needs_review source items
topic assignment must be deterministic from accepted skill/domain mapping
no runtime rule generation by AI
content_version changes when learner-visible normative content or evaluator answer changes
